intro: Working in public. Status badges are honest: drafts are drafts, and the open items are part of the exhibit.

projects.title: AI Warning Labels
projects.summary: A standardized hazard-communication framework for AI systems, adapted from GHS chemical labeling. Interactive label builder in progress; showcase live on the home page.

projects.title: Shadow AI & Shadow IT Governance Playbook
projects.summary: A vendor-neutral, five-phase operational playbook to discover, contain, govern, and continuously validate unsanctioned AI and shadow assets. EU AI Act / GDPR / NIST AI RMF anchored. Published as a working draft, review notes included on purpose.
projects.stack: governance · EU AI Act · IR · AI-BOM

projects.title: API Governance Dashboard
projects.summary: Companion asset-intelligence UI for the playbook: registry, compliance command center, and security-posture views for 4,000+ APIs. Three-persona design (governance leads, executives, security teams). Fake data, real design thinking.
projects.stack: ui design · asset intelligence · api security

projects.title: Writing, LinkedIn series
projects.summary: Two series: The Wrong Hire (ADHD, misfits, and security engineering in the agentic world) and What Free Services Collect About You. Build-in-public voice, contrarian takes.
